artworks.label: Jade court coffer
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for plume-court. One small aristocratic trinket coffer, softly rectangular ivory porcelain body with deep teal and jade-green enamel inlays, delicate antique-gold filigree hinges and feet, lid slightly ajar revealing pale satin lining, one small blue-green cabochon clasp. Subtle peacock-eye enamel ornament on lid, exquisitely restrained courtly craft photography, warm parchment reflected light, teal/jade/ivory/aged-gold palette. No actual bird, feather brooch, folding fan, fountain, clock or text. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
